listening: Distinguish a spending need based on necessity from a want. Our usage estimate assumes a frequency of three visits a week.
Compare a subscription plan with pay-as-you-go at the break-even point. A usage change affects variable cost but not fixed cost.
exam.reading:
Text 1: A surcharge or hidden fee can increase the upfront cost.

Text 2: Read the cancellation term for the minimum period and penalty.

Text 3: Flexibility may require a convenience premium and a trade-off in cost.

Text 4: Justify a purchase as cost-effective for your personal priority.
